ai_summary: Advent Hotels International is acquiring the remaining 25% equity in its subsidiary, BD And P Hotels (operator of the Hilton Mumbai International Airport), for Rs. 400 million to achieve full ownership and greater strategic control over this key hospitality asset. This consolidation will fully integrate the revenue-generating entity (FY26 turnover: Rs. 1.02 billion) into Advent's operations, allowing complete capture of its future profits and streamlining management. While clarified as not a related-party transaction, the substantial acquisition cost warrants further financial scrutiny given that profitability metrics for BD&P Hotels are not disclosed.
